prompt: Write a 3P update for the "Mobile Dev Team" covering the week April 15 to April 21. The update must strictly follow the 3P formatting: an emoji, the team name, and date range on the first line; followed by three sections labeled Progress, Plans, and Problems. Each section should contain 1-3 sentences focused on data-driven, measurable outcomes or blockers. The tone must be matter-of-fact and concise, suitable for executives and cross-team leadership who have limited context. Include at least one metric or numerical detail in Progress and Problems. Do not use any other formatting besides the structure provided. Output the entire update as plain text in a single .md file named "mobile_dev_3p_update.md" exactly.
